title: Cauchy–Schwarz for the integral over a finite measure space
statement: Let α be a type with a σ-algebra, μ a measure on α with μ(α) < ∞, and h : α → ℝ square-integrable (MemLp h 2 μ). Then (∫ h dμ)² ≤ μ(α)·∫ h² dμ, where μ(α) is read as a real number (ENNReal.toReal).
lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) (h : α → ℝ), μ univ ≠ ∞ → MemLp h 2 μ → (∫ x, h x ∂μ) ^ 2 ≤ (μ univ).toReal * ∫ x, h x ^ 2 ∂μ
